ECHO EXPERIMENT LOG - NODE 1
----------------------------
The anchor base was duplicated into dimension space /echo.
When scanning the copy, the baseline geometry is identical, but mutations manifest:
doors detach, flame sources extinguish, and an entity appears near the most-frequented station.
Use the Diff Lens to survey the divergence. Type 'diff' or check anomalies.
Remember: shadow divergences indicate where memory fails first.
- Odette
